name: Failed-flush continuation short (15m short, ADX confirms the down-trend is real)
rationale: MECHANISM (H6 with an ADX arm replacing the funding-room read): a failed flush that keeps bleeding is a genuine down-trend, not chop — a rising ADX confirms the directional force is real, distinguishing 'the ladder is still being consumed' from a noisy wiggle at the lows. OI falls, price makes new lows, no bounce, and ADX is elevated. Counterparty: the next tranche of margin-called longs liquidated lower. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (deleveraging) AND range_position below a very low floor (new lows) AND rsi below an oversold floor (still down) AND adx above a floor (the down-move is a real trend, not chop). DISCONFIRMER: must be time-disjoint from H1 — shared profitable bars mean the OI read is noise; range_position is the separator, so its removal must collapse the spec; and drop the ADX arm — if no degradation, the trend-confirmation was cosmetic. HIGHEST curve-fit risk of the family — kill unless a clean low-overlap OOS window clears fees.
catalyst: OI cross_down + new low + no bounce + rising ADX — a real down-trend still consuming the ladder
